fullPassage:
We first need to understand the short but hidden history behind the plastics industry and how it became deeply rooted in our daily lives. Before plastic, people lived more sustainably, with far fewer waste problems than we face today.

(C) However, after the invention of plastic, its rapid adoption during World War II, and its explosion into consumer goods, plastic was everywhere. The growing industry came to symbolize the convenience and prosperity of the American dream.

(B) This dream came at a price. Over time, people began to notice the environmental impact, and the early seeds of today's environmental movement were planted.

(A) However, the plastics industry was quick to counter these concerns, launching campaigns that presented recycling as the solution to all our problems. They pushed the idea that pollution was the fault of consumers, not the corporations flooding the market with plastic.

questions.passage: We first need to (A)[understand / misunderstand] the short but hidden history behind the plastics industry. Before plastic, people lived more (B)[sustainably / wastefully], with far fewer waste problems than we face today. However, after the invention of plastic, its rapid adoption during World War II, and its (C)[explosion / reduction] into consumer goods, plastic was everywhere.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 플라스틱 산업의 숨겨진 역사를 '이해해야(understand)' 하고, 플라스틱 이전에는 더 '지속 가능하게(sustainably)' 살았으며, 소비재로의 '폭발적 확산(explosion)'이 있었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① understand — sustainably — explosion: 원문 일치
❌ ② misunderstand(오해하다): understand가 원문
❌ ③ wastefully(낭비적으로): sustainably가 원문
❌ ④ reduction(축소): explosion이 원문

questions.passage: The growing industry came to (A)[symbolize / undermine] the convenience and prosperity of the American dream. This dream came at a (B)[price / discount]. Over time, people began to notice the environmental (C)[impact / benefit], and the early seeds of today's environmental movement were planted.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 성장하는 산업은 편리함과 번영을 '상징(symbolize)'했고, 이 꿈에는 '대가(price)'가 따랐으며, 환경적 '영향(impact)'을 알아차리기 시작했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ symbolize — price — impact: 원문 일치
❌ ① discount(할인): price가 원문
❌ ② undermine(약화시키다): symbolize가 원문
❌ ④ benefit(이점): impact가 원문
det.tip: symbolize=상징하다, at a price=대가를 치르고, impact=영향

questions.passage: The plastics industry was quick to (A)[counter / embrace] these concerns, launching campaigns that (B)[presented / dismissed] recycling as the solution to all our problems. They pushed the idea that pollution was the (C)[fault / responsibility] of consumers, not the corporations flooding the market with plastic.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 플라스틱 산업은 우려에 빠르게 '대응(counter)'했고, 재활용을 해결책으로 '제시(presented)'하는 캠페인을 시작했으며, 오염이 소비자의 '잘못(fault)'이라고 주장했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② counter — presented — fault: 원문 일치
❌ ① embrace(수용하다): counter가 원문
❌ ③ dismissed(무시하다): presented가 원문
❌ ④ responsibility(책임): fault가 원문 (뉘앙스 차이 — fault=탓/잘못)

det.analysis:

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② inconvenience(불편함)는 원문 convenience(편리함)의 반의어. 플라스틱 산업은 '편리함'을 상징했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① adoption: 원문 일치 (채택)
❌ ② inconvenience: 원문 convenience → 편리함
✅ ③ notice: 원문 일치 (알아차리다)
✅ ④ planted: 원문 일치 (심어졌다)

questions.passage: The plastics industry was quick to ①<u>counter</u> these concerns, launching ②<u>campaigns</u> that presented recycling as the solution to all our problems. They pushed the idea that ③<u>pollution</u> was the fault of consumers, not the corporations ④<u>draining</u> the market with plastic.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ draining(고갈시키는)은 원문 flooding(범람시키는)과 반대. 기업들이 시장에 플라스틱을 '범람'시켰다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① counter: 원문 일치 (반박하다)
✅ ② campaigns: 원문 일치 (캠페인)
✅ ③ pollution: 원문 일치 (오염)
❌ ④ draining: 원문 flooding → 범람시키다
